definitions.explanation: Being released from a hospital after treatment.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}{退院|たいいん}できます。
examples.english: You can leave the hospital next week.

notes:
{退院|たいいん} means being discharged from a hospital after treatment or recovery.

ETYMOLOGY:
{退|たい} (withdraw/leave) + {院|いん} (institution/hospital).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {退院|たいいん}する: to be discharged, to leave the hospital
- {退院|たいいん}できる: to be able to leave the hospital
- {退院|たいいん}{日|び}: discharge date
- {退院|たいいん}{届|とど}け: discharge notification form
- {退院|たいいん}おめでとう: Congratulations on your discharge!

CONTRAST:
- {入院|にゅういん}: hospitalization (entering the hospital)
- {通院|つういん}: outpatient visits (going to hospital without staying)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, it's common to visit someone who has {退院|たいいん} with a gift ({快気祝|かいきいわ}い) to celebrate their recovery. The patient may also give thank-you gifts ({快気内祝|かいきうちいわ}い) to those who visited during their stay.
